{{Top}}
'''Class Three infractions''' were one of the five categories of crime outlined in the [[Imperial Penal Code/Legends|Imperial Penal Code]] during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]] alongside [[Class Five infraction/Legends|Class Five]], [[Class Four infraction/Legends|Class Four]], [[Class Two infraction/Legends|Class Two]] and [[Class One infraction/Legends|Class One]] infractions.<ref name="GG6">''[[Galaxy Guide 6: Tramp Freighters]]''</ref> Crimes in this category included, but were not limited to: 
*Attempted bribery of an [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officer]]
*Transportation of high-technology without an Imperial permit or license
*Transportation of restriced items  without an Imperial permit or license

Standard Imperial punishment for this type of violation was the immediate arrest of the offender, whom was then brought to the [[Sector/Legends|sector]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] for trial. Without a good [[Lawyer/Legends|lawyer]] the defendant could have faced further punishment such as a [[Prison/Legends|prison]] sentence or a fine. In case a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] crew was found guilty of a Class Three infraction, their vessel and their vessel's [[Captain/Legends|captain]] could have also had their operating permits revoked.<ref name="GG6.2e">''[[Galaxy Guide 6: Tramp Freighters (Second Edition)]]</ref>
